description: This file contains Scala source code defining a wrapper class for UserDefinedAggregateFunction, a mutable row implementation, and associated encoders for Spark SQL aggregation operations.

classes.name: UserDefinedAggregateFunctionWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class that allows deprecated UserDefinedAggregateFunction to be used with the Aggregator interface, enabling execution and registration within Spark SQL.

classes.name: MutableRow
classes.description: A mutable implementation of a row used as an aggregation buffer, supporting in-place updates and conversion to a generic Row.

methods.name: zero
methods.description: Initializes a new MutableRow buffer and calls the UDAF's initialize method.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Updates the buffer with a new input row by calling the UDAF's update method.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges two MutableRow buffers by calling the UDAF's merge method.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Evaluates the aggregation result from the buffer by calling the UDAF's evaluate method.

methods.name: bufferEncoder
methods.description: Provides an Encoder for MutableRow buffers using a transforming encoder.

methods.name: outputEncoder
methods.description: Provides an Encoder for the output data type of the UDAF.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Creates a Codec for MutableRow to Row conversion.
